limitations: Exploratory candidate open-water inundation, not independently validated flood extent, water depth, damage, exposure, or an emergency warning.
The −16 dB post-event and 3 dB decrease thresholds are predeclared exploratory choices, not locally calibrated universal water thresholds or an accuracy guarantee.

Same relative orbit and pass reduce viewing-geometry differences. Earth Engine GRD is terrain-corrected, but is not radiometrically terrain-flattened; a <5° slope filter is not a layover/shadow correction.

Wet bare soil, smooth fields, land management, freeze/thaw, wind, SAR noise and changing incidence geometry can mimic or hide inundation. Urban or vegetation-covered flooding can increase backscatter or remain undetected.

Temporal medians and 30 m-radius spatial smoothing suppress speckle and also erase narrow, short-lived or heterogeneous flood signals. The 20 m export grid is not a claim of 20 m independent resolving power.
The post window is an event-period composite, not a simultaneous or peak flood snapshot. The pre window may already contain wet or flooded locations; no change is not proof of no flooding.

Baseline support comes from observed, documented ESA WorldCover 2020 land-cover classes, not from filling JRC no-data as dry land. Any contributing WorldCover permanent-water class 80, plus observed JRC2020 class 3, is excluded. Both baseline products can misclassify boundaries and miss changes before the event; seasonal water remains eligible.

WorldCover class 80 is aggregated conservatively: any native permanent-water overlap excludes the full 20 m analysis cell, widening water exclusions along boundaries. WorldCover2020 is a land-cover model, not independent field truth or proof of dry conditions in November 2021.
No-data, missing baseline/DEM, high slope, insufficient observations and permanent water are excluded from candidate evaluation; blank map pixels are not confirmed dry land.

The fixed bounding box covers a Lower Fraser case study. Results must not be extrapolated to the whole British Columbia event. No SAR coherence or earthquake/tornado damage inference is performed by this module.

provenance.method: Sentinel-1 VV candidate open-water inundation; direct authenticated satellite processing

revision.reason: Returned v1 run had JRC2020 no-data at 2,371,570 of 2,534,825 domain cells (93.56%); it could not support an AOI-wide candidate interpretation. A separate observed WorldCover2020 baseline and full-domain known-baseline gate replace the assumption that JRC yearly support defines eligible land. Source JRC no-data remains unchanged.
revision.range_guard_revision: Six post pixels exceeded the arbitrary+20dB screening value (maximum21.9404dB); none was v1 eligible. V2 retains and flags finite strong returns for review rather than clipping/rejecting them by an unsupported universalphysicalceiling.
revision.unchanged: AOI, analysisgrid, pre/postdates, orbitcoverage-selectioncriterion, smoothing, incidencefilter, observationcountthresholds, slope and centralSARcandidate thresholds

selection.criterion: Largest shared SAR valid area only, before examining flood candidate values; ties by pass then relative orbit

track_inventory.reason: Enough same-track independent acquisitions; evaluate shared coverage

provenance.compositing: Deterministic mosaic of slices per platform+absolute orbit; native VV dB converted to linear power; circular mean speckle smoothing; mean to fixed 20 m grid with full neighborhood/child-pixel support; temporal median linear power; convert to dB
provenance.candidate_definition: post_vv_db <= post_vv_max_db AND delta_vv_db <= -decrease_min_db, within eligible support only
provenance.coverage_definition: Full physical pixel areas for cells with centres inside the declared WGS84 box, on the anchored 20 m grid, exactly as the common exporter. Shared SAR support has sufficient independent observations in both windows. Independent WorldCover2020 known baseline must also cover at least80% domain. Eligible additionally requires valid low slope and no native WorldCover80 overlap or observed JRC2020class3. JRC no-data remains unknown contextual information and never establishes dry land.
provenance.baseline_aggregation: WorldCover2020 documented categories remapped to known support; minimum support across all contributing native10m cells. Permanent-water fraction is the area-weighted mean of nativeclass80 flags; any positive fraction excludes whole20m cell. Mode land-cover class is context only, not used to exclude water. Raw JRC2020 classifications remain separate.
provenance.backscatter_range_policy: Preserve all finite positive-power representable observations. Returns outside exploratory[-60,+20]dB screening range are retained unchanged and flagged with counts/locations/eligible involvement for review; the range is not a physicalbound and never clips pixels or relaxes flood thresholds.
